trickyParts: Abandoned writes can land after the 503: interest and session Puts are idempotent and last-writer-wins as before; conditional deletes and role-claim Create/Update are CAS on the revision read, so they never overwrite a later write; once ctx ends, a failed claim's rollback and the old holder's cleanup are not started, so an interest record can name a role topic its session does not hold until the next claim or unsubscribe (role delivery reads the claim, not the topic). cistore's abandoned Create/Update is a CAS at the revision read.

The CI record is bounded at 4 s (two cistore write budgets) rather than 2 s, because TestASlowKVCallOnALiveConnectionIsWaitedFor requires a slow-but-live KV call inside one budget to be waited for; GitHub's own limit is 10 s.

Batched cistore callers share the bound of the caller writing the batch; Slack's publish runs under 2.5 s from the handler's start (Slack waits 3 s); GhostWispr has no published deadline and keeps the request ctx with the 5 s publish cap.
